summary: Iteration 5 verified the PHED Survey Review filter enhancements end-to-end. Backend pytest (9/9 PASS via /app/backend/tests/test_phed_review_filters_iter5.py against external URL): (1) GET /api/phed/filters returns exactly the 8 expected survey_connection_types tuples [PROPERTY_LOCKED..OWNERSHIP_CHANGE] with correct labels; (2) GET /api/phed/surveys returns 200 with baseline; (3) colony filter is case-insensitive & trimmed (variants 'Didar Nagar', 'didar nagar', '  DIDAR NAGAR  ' all match); (4) date_from=date_to=2026-09-12 inclusively returns PL0001; (5) malformed date returns 400; (6) all 8 connection_type values return 200 (no 500s); (7) invalid connection_type returns 400; (8) combined date+PROPERTY_LOCKED returns exactly PL0001 with owner_name='Verify Owner 1', mobile 9000000001, ward '27', colony 'Didar Nagar', status Submitted, submitted_at starts 2026-09-12, water.property_locked=true; (9) unauth rejected. Frontend Playwright (admin @ Thanesar, 1920x1080 then 390x844): all 8 filter data-testids (survey-search-input, survey-filter-status/ward/surveyor/colony/date-from/date-to/connection-type) present. Applying From 2026-09-12 + To 2026-09-12 + 'Property locked' yielded exactly 1 row (PL0001) with UI cells: consumer-id '—', name 'Verify Owner 1', mobile '9000000001', ward '27', colony 'Didar Nagar', surveyor 'Surveyor One', connection badge 'Property Locked', status 'Submitted', submitted '9/12/2026'. Ward is 27 (NOT 1) as clarified by main agent. At 390px viewport, document.scrollWidth-clientWidth = 0 (no page-level horizontal overflow) and the table sits inside its own horizontal scroller (parent clientWidth=356, scrollWidth=947). Code review of consumerIdOf() and connectionLabel() in PhedSurveys.js confirms deterministic precedence (property_locked > owner_denied > DEATH_TRANSFER > OWNERSHIP_CHANGE > new_connection/NO_CONNECTION -> 'New Connection' > water+sewer > sewer > water/has_connection/WATER_CONNECTION -> 'Already Connection', else '—'); consumerIdOf returns 'New Connection' only for new-connection outcome/type and water.consumer_id otherwise (never a slash or connection-number fallback). Only PL0001 exists in the dataset today; no other connection_type currently has data (total=0 for the remaining 7) which is expected per the review instructions — this is data coverage, not a product defect. No records were modified.
critical_code_review_comments: phed.py list_surveys() correctly parses YYYY-MM-DD via datetime.fromisoformat, applies inclusive $lt next-day upper bound, raises 400 on bad format, and uses $and-append for connection_type so it composes cleanly with any $or from search. Good pattern.
filter_options() exposes exactly the 8 required tuples in the correct order. Labels match request.

PhedSurveys.js connectionLabel() precedence matches the spec (locked > denied > death > ownership > new > water+sewer > sewer > already > —). consumerIdOf() only returns 'New Connection' for new-connection surveys and never falls back to a water connection number.
phed.py remains large (>2400 lines); non-blocking recommendation to split into domain modules.
